# Boozy Estate

> Boozy Estate is a vintage and collectible liquor information hub. It provides historical reference data, valuation guides, and a searchable database of 2,289 Jim Beam, Ezra Brooks, Ski Country, and Wild Turkey ceramic decanters — year issued, mintage, and estimated dealer value sourced from Tom Dunn's Bottle Collectors Pocket Price Guide (2016 ed.). The site also covers the history of American whiskey from colonial times to the present, and hosts a detailed identification guide for Rémy Martin Louis XIII Baccarat crystal decanters spanning 1874–1999.

## Pages

- [Home](https://boozyestate.com/): Overview of the site, about section, and navigation to all major features.
- [History of American Whiskey](https://boozyestate.com/history.html): A chronological timeline of American whiskey — 9 eras from 1600s colonial corn mash through Prohibition, the Regal China decanter boom (1955–1992), and the modern craft revival. Includes brand tiles, period bottle images, and whiskey term tooltips.
- [Valuing Your Collection](https://boozyestate.com/valuing.html): How collectible whiskey decanters are priced across three markets (estate sales, collector shows, online resellers). Covers the 6 key value factors: condition, fill level, original box, mintage, rarity, and subject matter.
- [The Collection](https://boozyestate.com/collection.html): A rotating showcase of 12 bottles from the 319-bottle Boozy Estate vault — Jim Beam Regal China decanters and Hoffman pieces from the Regal China era (1955–1992). Each card links to a deep-dive modal with provenance, specs, and market context.
- [Decanter Database](https://boozyestate.com/decanters.html): Searchable and filterable database of 2,289 decanters across 22 categories. Brands: Jim Beam (Regal China), Ezra Brooks, Ski Country, JB Go-Withs, Wild Turkey. Fields: name, year, mintage, estimated value, series, vault status. Wild Turkey entries include weight and yield specs.
- [Louis XIII Identification Guide](https://boozyestate.com/louis-xiii.html): A cinematic reference guide for identifying Rémy Martin Louis XIII Baccarat crystal cognac decanters by era (1874–1999). Covers 9 eras with 74 photographs. Key identifiers: fin shape, base engraving, stopper style, label, neck card, and packaging.
- [Contact](https://boozyestate.com/contact.html): Contact form for collection inquiries and questions about the site.

## Data Notes

- All decanter values are historical dealer estimates from a 2016 price guide. They are not current market prices.
- The Boozy Estate vault is managed through Baxus (baxus.co), a blockchain-based spirits custody platform.
- 319 bottles are currently vaulted. 37 additional decanters are owned but never filled (convention-only automotive pieces).
- Wild Turkey ceramic decanters (1971–1986) include Original Series (Nos. 1–8), Lore Series (Nos. 1–4), New Direction/Action Series (Nos. 1–12), miniature series, and special decanters.
- Louis XIII guide source: research by Michael at Vieux Cognacs (vieuxcognacs.com), October 2013.
